owner_decisions: Never weaken the signing chain to verify-only: double-compute → ct_eq → verify-before-release under the CFI counter is mandatory (CLAUDE.md Code Conventions; Genêt TCHES 2023). Any FI 'simplification' that removes a sign pass or the ct_eq is forbidden.
OptRand is deliberately drawn ONCE and shared by both passes (byte-equality gate), while shuffle seeds are deliberately INDEPENDENT per pass (crypto.rs:206-303) — do not 'fix' either direction.

FI-delay length comes from the platform TRNG only, never rng_strong (sign-latency cliff; fi.rs:34-44). Owner decision 2026-10-09 (#834): 'if the RNG fails, we shouldn't fallback. It should error out' — the policy stands, but #835 rejected implementing 'error out' as a device halt; the operation must fail and the device must live. CLAUDE.md master 165577a5 scopes 'No software PRNG' to secrets with stated conditions for countermeasure timing.

ML-KEM-1024 inner wrap on the SE tunnels DESCOPED 2026-07-07 — do not re-raise (invariant #3); consequence: per-device final credential rotation is load-bearing and tunnel-establishment FI hardening must assume symmetric-only channels.
OPTIGA S-1/S-2/S-3 lockdown deferred by design (chips cost money, LcsO irreversible); do not flag FI/FV work as avoidance of them.
SHAKE-vs-SHA2 is DECIDED: stay on plain SHA-2; masked SHA-2/SHAKE judged too expensive — constrains any masking-based FI/SCA proposal for the C10 core.

RDP-2 burn must be user-confirm gated (2026-07-17 R2.4) and WRP-set → RDP-2 ordering is mandatory; no runtime write path may touch the FSBL range and the FSBL must never grow an option-byte write path (Draft 1.2 C1) — tz-1 stays read-only.
Verify-once-physically trust chain (2026-07-21, invariant #10): the FSBL boot-time fingerprint window is the anchor; a later fake screen is the accepted residual.
tamp-wipe / tzic-wipe default OFF for bench safety and forced ON for shipping dual-SE images via the nsc/mod.rs MEDIUM-1 fence; bench images must not brick under a probe-rs-induced false ITAMP9.
Glitch halts must not touch the display or any attacker-reachable peripheral (#484 rule) — silence is deliberate; wiping SRAM before halting is not excluded by that rule (#835 H4).
Scroll-to-end consent gate is ON (2026-09-24, PX_COMMIT_REQUIRES_SEEN_LAST=true) and the sign gesture is the two-button chord click (2026-09-22) — do not re-litigate without new evidence.
Standalone TROPIC01 backend removed 2026-07-14; dual-SE (OPTIGA + SE050) only. No classical signer anywhere, including FW-update and FSBL.
Trezor secmon port declined on principle (separate signed image trusting NS); MPU-lite split of large parsers is the stated real residual (trezor-comparison.md:7).

Draft 1.1 rollback manifest / OTP floor work is not implementation-approved; the FSBL's unary OTP tally and try-once page are legacy bench-only — FI work on those paths is source-level retention, not production coverage.
